description: Margin Minder dashboard with saved scenario counts, average margin, below-target count, recent scenarios, and quick actions.
notes: Required by .aidd/spec.md; current /dashboard is the template system dashboard rather than a pricing health dashboard.
spec:
1. Replace or adapt the dashboard first screen for Margin Minder pricing health.
2. Show total saved scenarios — use aggregate COUNT queries, do NOT load full scenario details for count metrics.
3. Show draft scenario count — use aggregate COUNT queries.
4. Show scenarios below target margin.
5. Show average gross margin across active scenarios.
6. Show recent scenarios with customer, title, status, total price, margin, and last updated — limit detail loading to 5 scenarios (RECENT_SCENARIOS_LIMIT) and cap total detail queries at 100 rows (DASHBOARD_DETAIL_LIMIT).
7. Include quick action to create a new scenario.
8. Include quick action to open the cost catalog.
9. Use compact operational metrics rather than a marketing hero.
10. Keep default route pointing to /dashboard.
11. Dashboard queries must use aggregate SQL for all count metrics (totalScenarios, draftCount) and limit detail loading to 5 recent scenarios — do NOT call getScenarioDetail() in a loop over unbounded result sets.
title: Pricing Dashboard
